intro.title: About this Application
intro.description: You can enjoy conversations with 3D characters using only a web browser. You can communicate with characters using microphone, text input, and voice synthesis, and also change characters (VRM), configure personality, and adjust voice.
intro.techDescription2: , for dialogue, voice synthesis, and speech recognition:
intro.githubDescription: This demo's source code is available on GitHub. Feel free to modify and improve it!
intro.usageDescription: Please do not intentionally induce discriminatory or violent statements, or statements that demean specific individuals. When replacing characters using VRM models, please follow the model's terms of use.

intro.geminiKeyDescription2: . Please enter the obtained API key in the form.
intro.geminiKeyNote: Gemini Live API is accessed directly from the browser. API keys and conversation content are not saved on servers.
